Wavemaker is Southeast Asia's leading VC firm investing in Enterprise, Deep Tech, and

 Sustainability startups. Since 2012, we have backed over 200 companies across multiple funds, guided by our thesis:

 • ﻿We invest in trustworthy & curious founders who have built conviction through experience and industry insights, and identified large opportunities because they see the world diﬀerently.
• We invest in scalable, capital-eﬃcient, defensible businesses that solve meaningful problems 10x better than existing options.
 
 With a large portfolio of early-stage companies, we are building our Portfolio Management team to put our founders at the center of our universe and ensure our startups are optimally supported in their early-stage journey as they build their business

 How you make an impact 

 You play an important role in supporting the database management requirements and data needs of Wavemaker internal teams, while getting a front-row seat to how a VC firm operates – from portfolio tracking to how investment teams use data to make decisions.

 • You will diligently support the Portfolio Management Team in auditing our core relational databases across portfolio companies, entities, and ecosystem contacts – mapping where data points are sourced, surfacing redundancies, and coordinating with other teams to establish the process, platform, and timing behind their data.
• You will help build end-to-end systems for internal teams and external partners, from populating and structuring Airtable bases to designing user interfaces, setting up automations, and preparing databases for AI-powered use.
• You will also help clean, organize, and enrich existing CRM data so it can be used reliably downstream.
• You are numerically strong and have a knack for numbers.
• You're comfortable working with large data sets and drawing insights from analysis of data.
• You are curious about new tools and pick them up quickly.
• You consistently work in a meticulous manner and with a high degree of attention to detail.
 
 What we look for 

 You put people first!

 Motivation 

 You love early-stage tech startups, innovation and venture capital. You want to make a move to immerse yourself into this world.

 Background 

 • You're currently studying towards a Bachelor's or Master's degree. We're open to diﬀerent fields of study!
• You have had at least 1-2 other internships
 
 Skillset 

 • ﻿﻿ You are highly process-oriented and methodical in your approach.
• You can switch easily between working meticulously with a high degree of attention to detail, and looking at the big picture and thinking strategically while being laser-focused on your task at hand, you have no problems juggling multiple balls at the same time.
• You are thoughtful, possessing strong analytical skills and critical thinking skills.
• You are extremely service-oriented and have the ability to build trust and forge long-term relationships with people of all backgrounds
• You are articulate and eloquent both in written and verbal communication
 
 Mindset 

 • You are intellectually curious and have an unquenchable thirst for knowledge.
• You're not afraid to say, "I don't know", but you pick things up quickly and roll up your sleeves.
• While remaining flexible and adaptable, you are able to uphold your integrity and conduct yourself in an ethical manner.
• You are a self-starter with tons of initiative. You don't need to wait around for instructions and you proactively propose solutions.
• You are independent and self-managed, with a bias for continuous contribution to the team.
 
 Why work with us? 

 We put people first!

 Founders 

 We know how much you admire entrepreneurs - their innovation, their grit, and their courage. So do we! Our motivations are aligned to invest in and support these entrepreneurs who have the courage to solve meaningful problems.

 Community 

 We build and nurture a trusted community of successful and inspiring entrepreneurs, advisors and industry experts, visionary and progressive investors, and supportive vendor partners.

 You 

 This opportunity will immerse you deep into the world of startups, innovation and venture capital! You will gain valuable experience and skills in the investment process as well as value creation for startups to help them scale.

 We view wellbeing holistically so for us, it includes physical and mental wellbeing, environmental and social wellbeing, and intellectual and spiritual wellbeing. We run initiatives that ensure all aspects of wellbeing are considered.

About Aegis Ventures 

 Aegis Ventures partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to launch and scale transformative companies in digital health and artificial intelligence. Our platform brings together market-shaping ideas, growth capital, and ambitious individuals to solve major societal problems. With a focus on innovations in healthcare, Aegis has launched four successful portfolio companies in partnership with Northwell Health and recently announced the Digital Consortium to co-develop, invest in, and launch new companies.

 About the Company 

 Aegis Ventures is a next-generation startup studio that partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to originate, launch, and scale transformative companies, with a focus on artificial intelligence. The Aegis platform brings together market-shaping ideas, permanent growth capital, and ambitious individuals who are driven to solve major societal problems. Our companies use technology to transform healthcare by dramatically improving quality, access, and cost. Aegis creates new companies with substantial input from our Digital Consortium of a dozen leading health systems and other ecosystem partners. We have launched 6 innovative companies to date and are just getting started.

 About the Job 

 As a  Venture Fellow at Aegis Ventures, you will have a unique opportunity to apply your clinical knowledge and business acumen in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are seeking a motivated graduate student with a strong background in consulting, finance, or business to join our team part-time.

 You will work closely with our leadership team to conduct due diligence on new investment opportunities, build new companies, and support the growth of our portfolio companies. Venture Fellows are expected to commit a minimum of two semesters, with a weekly time commitment of approximately 15 hours. This role can be remote within the U.S. or based in New York.

 What You'll Do 

• Evaluate new investment opportunities through due diligence.

• Help develop and launch new healthcare companies, from initial concept and business model development through company formation.

• Collaborate with Aegis portfolio companies on strategic priorities, including growth, partnerships, fundraising, and new market opportunities.

• Support a range of strategic initiatives across the Aegis platform, including thought leadership, industry events, and ecosystem engagement.

 What You'll Need 

• Currently enrolled in a graduate program.

• Previous experience in consulting, investment banking, or business.

• A desire to make a positive impact on patient outcomes.

• Ability to work independently with strong problem-solving and communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and with AI.

 What We Offer 

• Experience evaluating early-stage investment opportunities.

• Exposure to many different business models within healthcare.

• A strong network of healthcare executives and entrepreneurs.

• Opportunities to participate in events and thought leadership initiatives.

• Hourly compensation.

 Hourly Rate 

• $50.00 per hour.

 Aegis Ventures is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer — we recruit, train, compensate and promote our team members based on qualifications. We encourage you to apply regardless of your race, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics.
